note: Alberta Parks recreation area campground 44 km west of Rocky Mountain House on Hwy 11, then 2 km north: five sites in the forest at the southeast end of Jackfish Lake, beside the boat launch and floating dock. A group site is at the north end of the lake. No camp shelter and no firewood on site (sold at Chambers Creek Campground, 15 miles east). OHVs must stay on their trailers inside the park; trails and staging areas are nearby. --Claude
